notes.title: Sky Reclaimers Demo is released
notes.notes:
[h1]You can now officially play the Sky Reclaimers demo!
[/h1]
[h2]What can you expect in the demo?[/h2]

[h3]Airships[/h3]
Your job is to protect the aircraft fortress. Build airships to collect resources and build a fleet of airship fighters to defend against dragons and rebels. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513926/39eaee4ed67533e151584dbe76fc5f9e4c72152c.png[/img]

[h3]Dragons[/h3]
Waves of dragons will approach your airship. You must defend against ordinary green dragons, to yellow fast dragons, to tiny blue dragons and come face to face with mega killer dragons...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513926/ed3d1b5c30973c1fad4e9969b2a8a60620e4cc01.png[/img]


[h3]Rebels[/h3]
Your not the only aircraft in the skies. When humanity was overwhelmed by dragons, they fractured into smaller factions. Here, these rebel groups have copied your airships and intend to be the only aircraft nation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513926/613bce6bbc719b46b40bb88ed30ab2a329b09a72.png[/img]

Thanks for reading this demo update. Play the demo and give us a review on the demo page! 

Cheers,
Luke
